expectations.text: Returns only a Spanish message and preserves Rioplatense voseo, including forms such as podés, pasá, and traé rather than switching to tú or usted.
expectations.evidence: The sole Spanish message retains "si podés, pasá" and "Traé el cuaderno azul"; no tú or usted forms replace the voseo.

expectations.text: Keeps the familiar relationship and conversational register represented by Che, Vale and porfa; does not add formal salutations or a professional sign-off.
expectations.evidence: "Che, Vale:" and "porfa" remain. The message ends "a la misma hora" without a formal salutation or sign-off.

expectations.text: Removes the accidental repetition of después de las seis while preserving Thursday after six as the initial meeting time.
expectations.evidence: "el jueves después de las seis" occurs once; the source’s immediate repetition is removed while Thursday after six remains.

expectations.text: Keeps two budgets on the table, Lucía's approval of one unspecified budget, and the uncertainty about which one she approved.
expectations.evidence: "Dejé dos presupuestos arriba de la mesa; Lucía dijo que aprobó uno, pero no me dijo cuál." Both the count and unresolved identity remain.

expectations.text: Preserves the instruction not to order wood yet and the request to bring the blue notebook.
expectations.evidence: "No encargues la madera todavía. Traé el cuaderno azul, porfa." Both instructions and the notebook color remain.

expectations.text: Preserves the conditional fallback: if it rains, meet Friday by video call at the same time; does not turn the fallback into an unconditional rescheduling.
expectations.evidence: "Si llueve, lo vemos el viernes por videollamada, a la misma hora." The rain condition, Friday fallback, medium and same-time relation remain.

review_method: Independent single blind agent review; not human feedback
